definitions.milledKg: grain fed into the roller mills (process-genealogy inputKg on roller_mill units)
definitions.packedKg: flour and semolina leaving the packers (process-genealogy outputs on packer units)
definitions.shippedKg: materialFlowStore.shippedKg delta over the window (departed manifests)
definitions.net: shiftMargin(report.metrics): revenue less every cost line
definitions.minutesAnyMachineDown: game minutes with at least one machine in critical status
definitions.machineDownMinutes: sum over machines of game minutes in critical status
definitions.packerIdleMinutes: game minutes with zero packer flow
definitions.qualityFailureKg: the shift report metrics.qualityFailureKg (shipped below the recipe minimum)
definitions.minProductQuality: lowest productionStore metrics.quality stamped on a tick in the window
definitions.shift0: the 10:00-14:00 opening window, partial; the ten whole shifts follow it
definitions.idleNoOrder: packer flow zero, no open order
definitions.idleOwedPacked: packer flow zero, every owed kg already packed (the order book binds)
definitions.idleOwedUnpacked: packer flow zero with owed kg unpacked (filling, changeover, starvation, a unit down)
definitions.runMillLimited: packers running, mills nearest their rated capacity (processed / rate x plant s x speed)
definitions.runSifterLimited: packers running, sifters nearest their rated capacity
definitions.runPackerLimited: packers running, packers nearest their rated capacity
definitions.packerUtilisationRunning: mean packer processed / rated capacity while the line runs
definitions.stockWaitingForTruck: released packed stock owed to a customer, no truck at the door
definitions.truckLoading: shipping truck at the door, loading
definitions.truckWaitingForMaterial: shipping truck at the door, held waiting for product
definitions.outageMinutes: game minutes with a lever outage unit in critical status
definitions.servicePartsUsed: parts consumed by Maintain presses (one each)
